# Orbiter Automations

> Orbiter Automations is a digital agency that builds modern websites, AI assistants, and business automation systems designed to help businesses attract, convert, and manage customers.

## Company

Orbiter Automations helps businesses improve their digital presence through high-performance websites, AI-powered customer interaction, automation, SEO, analytics, and ongoing digital support.

## Services

- Website Design & Development
  Modern, responsive websites designed around business goals, brand identity, user experience, and conversion.

- AI Assistants
  AI-powered website assistants that can answer customer questions, provide business information, capture leads, qualify prospects, and assist customers.

- Business Automation
  Automated workflows that connect websites, forms, AI systems, databases, email, calendars, notifications, and other business tools.

- SEO & Analytics
  Search engine optimization, website analytics, performance tracking, and reporting designed to improve online visibility and understand customer behavior.

- Digital Growth & Maintenance
  Ongoing website updates, digital improvements, marketing support, analytics, and reporting.

## Solutions

Orbiter Automations can build systems that:

- Capture and qualify leads
- Answer customer questions automatically
- Book appointments
- Connect customer data to business systems
- Send automated emails and notifications
- Connect websites with calendars and databases
- Automate repetitive business processes
- Provide analytics and reporting
